questions.q: In "Batteries, charging and high-voltage safety Apply", which of these is a key idea?

Range = pack 60 kWh / 16 kWh per 100 km x 100 = 375 km (ideal; in cold or at speed it is less).

questions.q: In "Write the maintenance checklist Apply", which of these is a key idea?
o: Owner checks: tyre pressure and wear, wiper blades, lights, brake fluid level, coolant level where visible, warning lights, charge cable condition.
